# <b>npis</b>

## Installation

You can install `npis` from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("andrewallenbruce/npis")
```

### :balance_scale: Code of Conduct

Please note that the **`npis`** project is released with a [Contributor Code of Conduct](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/npis/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html). By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.


### :classical_building: Governance

This project is primarily maintained by [Andrew Bruce](https://github.com/andrewallenbruce). Other authors may occasionally assist with some of these duties.
